a.text: 'It must be sharper than any blade, colder than the harshest snowfields, and weightier than any memory.'
'Honestly, I don't know whether I'll be able to bear the stabbing pain in my heart to pick it up.'
'I'm not expecting to write anything with it. Perhaps, more than anything, I wish for it to become the final paragraph in my collection of the days of old.'

steps.name: Meticulous Durin
steps.text: Those are the details of the job, and I guarantee you I memorized the whole thing down to the letter.

steps.name: Indolent Durin
steps.text: Really? She was mumbling toward the end there. Are you sure you didn't mishear anything?

steps.name: Meticulous Durin
steps.text: Nope.

steps.name: Meticulous Durin?
steps.text: Anyway, it's been half a month. How do you even remember how quiet she was?

steps.name: Indolent Durin
steps.text: I mean, don't you think it's weird? At first, she said she wanted a fountain pen, and would be fine with whatever design we came up with.

steps.name: Indolent Durin
steps.text: But all that stuff she said at the end... Are you sure that was meant for us, and not herself?

steps.name: Meticulous Durin?
steps.text: Nope.

steps.name: Meticulous Durin?
steps.text: —Wait, hold on. It's been half a month?

steps.name: Meticulous Durin?
steps.text: And we still haven't started on the design?

steps.name: Indolent Durin
steps.text: It's only been half a month. I hadn't sharpened my pencils, and... I was out of mead.

spans.text: been half a month. I hadn't sharpened my pencils, and... I was out of mead.

steps.name: Meticulous Durin?
steps.text: Fair point. Okay, bottoms up.

steps.name: Indolent Durin
steps.text: Bottoms up! —Ugh, dude, what do you think she was asking for, anyway?

steps.name: Meticulous Durin?
steps.text: Look at her word choice... She probably meant she wants something that's good for fighting, something cold and heavy.

steps.name: Indolent Durin
steps.text: Ohh, then probably some kind of huge ass weapon, made out of metal?

steps.name: Meticulous Durin?
steps.text: And we need to add something to give it a bit of a fountain pen look.

steps.name: Indolent Durin
steps.text: Just a bit? Let's add that right here, then. It'll look great.

steps.name: Meticulous Durin?
steps.text: Ooh, I like it! I mean, you just scribbled something on there, but this is a pretty decent blueprint!

steps.name: Meticulous Durin?
steps.text: So... What is it?

steps.name: Indolent Durin
steps.text: It looks like... a crossbow? What do you think?

steps.name: Meticulous Durin?
steps.text: Oh yeah, I can see it, now that you mention it. Then I can start designing the structure. I daresay this is gonna be a masterpiece. Even more amazing than anything you've seen in Stranger Things.

spans.text: Oh yeah, I can see it, now that you mention it. Then I can start designing the structure. I daresay this is gonna be a masterpiece. Even more amazing than anything you've seen in

steps.name: Indolent Durin
steps.text: Yeah, that's what I'm talking about. And it better be, for a surface-dweller customer to walk away satisfied.

steps.name: Meticulous Durin?
steps.text: Hear, hear. Bottoms up again!

steps.name: Meticulous Durin?
steps.text: Well, that's all the work we have for today. Time to celebrate!

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: '...This is the largest fluorescent mushroom in Zeruertzan history.'

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: *sigh*... This Legendary Explorer's Zeruertzan History Uncovered doesn't have much useful information.

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: Seventeen updated cave maps over three years... yet it doesn't go into the upheavals the city has faced, or the ambitions of those in power.

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: Perhaps I need to look for literature left behind by earlier outsiders, or learn Durish. Only then will I uncover Zeruertza's true history, apart from these suspiciously cheery broken sentences.

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: ...After all, my eyes do not deceive me.

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: Everyone here is a binge drinker! Every! Last! One!

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: No... Now that I've escaped that place... I need to put it all behind me.

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: Perhaps the Durins are the same. Why else would they be drowning their sorrows, if not to bury the memory of some shared trauma?

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: Until I can understand their pain, this unspoken taboo, I won't ever truly be one of them.

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: They may act carefree, but I can tell they haven't fully accepted me. I can see the hostility behind their glances.

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: I mean, why else would there be no updates on my fountain pen after half a month?!

steps.name: Deculture Silvermint
steps.text: Hello, Avdotya. Is something the matter?

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: Oh, my apologies. Am I talking too loudly in the library?

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: After my long, lonesome journey, it's been hard to break the habit of speaking to myself.

steps.name: Tipsy Voice
steps.text: Look at this! What did I tell you? They wrote about that nut ice cream eating competition we had in Issue 1201!

steps.name: Comparatively Calm Voice
steps.text: Dude, you're holding it upside down. That's Issue 1051. Besides, that's not even you in the picture.

steps.name: Deculture Silvermint
steps.text: I think you're being relatively quiet, actually.

steps.name: Deculture Silvermint
steps.text: Anyway, you told me earlier you were afraid of the library's robots since they looked like... uh... military equipment, so I've made sure they won't approach you.

steps.name: Deculture Silvermint
steps.text: If you're looking for anything specific, just ask me directly.

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: Thank you.

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: Really, all I need to know is how these books are sorted. That would help me find what I'm looking for.

steps.name: Deculture Silvermint
steps.text: Hm... how the books are sorted... I remember there being a book on that.

steps.name: Deculture Silvermint
steps.text: But I don't remember where it is. Hold on, let me get a ladder.

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: Shouldn't the sorting system dictate where it is?

steps.name: Deculture Silvermint
steps.text: Hm, I don't remember that, either.

steps.name: Deculture Silvermint
steps.text: I mean, 80% of the books here aren't where they're supposed to be anyway, according to the system.

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: I appreciate your assistance.

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: But I think I'll take a walk around town. I'm sure that will help me assimilate.

steps.name: Deculture Silvermint
steps.text: Avdotya, since you love hanging out at the library so much, have you considered writing for Zeruertza?

steps.name: Deculture Silvermint
steps.text: I'm very curious what surface-dwellers like those in Stranger Things think of our Durin city.

spans.text: I'm very curious what surface-dwellers like those in

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: I haven't.

steps.name: Deculture Silvermint
steps.text: I... Sorry, did I offend you?

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: It's not you, it's me. This is a problem I must face on my own.

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: To completely rid myself of my memories of the surface, I refuse to do anything that I used to do up there.

steps.name: Deculture Silvermint
steps.text: That's a shame. So you're not hoping to be a writer? In that case, you should broaden your horizons somewhere more open.

steps.name: Deculture Silvermint
steps.text: When you leave, just put anything you pulled off the shelves wherever you want. Also, be careful when you leave through the exit. Lately, we've been getting a lot of drunk Durins racing there.

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: ...Thanks for the warning.

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: Oh, but I have one more question.

steps.name: Deculture Silvermint
steps.text: What is it?

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: How do Durin surnames work?

steps.name: Deculture Silvermint
steps.text: There aren't any rules. For example, I'm Silvermint. The chief is Eartheart...

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: So they're all objects or concepts.

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: (To the Durins, these surnames are nothing unusual, yet I can't help but focus on the meaning behind them.)

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: ...I see. Thank you.

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: An omnipresent artificial daylight... a city with no winter.

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: How can I hide the breath of winter enveloping me? How do I avoid hurting the Durins' captious eyes?

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: If I must abandon my entire past and take refuge under the roof of strangers to avoid banishment or betrayal... All the better.

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: Here it is...

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: If I remember correctly, the two craftsmen's hut is around—

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: —Huh?

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: A big slide... but there are no stairs leading up...

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: There's half a trampoline, but no barriers...

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: What are these things?

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: Excuse me. Why are all these entertainment facilities left half-finished, and what are they doing here?

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: Also, wasn't there a craftsman's shop that took commissions here?

steps.name: Thrilled Durin
steps.text: Hey! I caught another one!

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: Caught...? Where are you taking me?!

steps.name: Thrilled Durin
steps.text: To the polls, of course!

steps.name: Thrilled Durin
steps.text: Oh, look how surprised you are. Have you been living under a rock? How could you have missed this street's renovation contest?!

steps.name: Thrilled Durin
steps.text: We're on the third wave of submissions!

steps.name: Thrilled Durin
steps.text: And to make it easy for the voters to decide how the street will be rebuilt, they added a new rule this time.

steps.name: Thrilled Durin
steps.text: Every contestant must build part of their design, and then—

steps.name: Thrilled Durin
steps.text: —the spectators vote for whichever one they want to see completed the most!

steps.name: Thrilled Durin
steps.text: How's that? That got you interested, didn't it?

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: No, not one bit. I just wanted to know where the people who used to be on this street went.

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: Were they chased away, just like that? Or were they exiled into the caves of Durin, where no daylight will ever reach...

steps.name: Thrilled Durin
steps.text: Come on, let's get voting!

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: *sigh*...

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: If this is your way of life, who am I to refuse?

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: But look how tall I am. I literally stand out from the crowd. What will the Durins think of me if my vote ends up in the minority?

steps.name: Thrilled Durin
steps.text: Yeah, you sure are tall.

steps.name: Thrilled Durin
steps.text: That's why you're the perfect candidate for record keeper! No one here can count votes better than you!

steps.name: Thrilled Durin
steps.text: We actually had three record keepers picked out before you, but not one of them came today. My guess is they're all drunk.

steps.name: Thrilled Durin
steps.text: Which is why the position is open!

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: Alright... Let's go, then.

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: 20 votes for 'Super Alcohol Stirrer Bumper Cars'!

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: And 309 abstentions!

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: The majority didn't vote!

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: *sigh*... The Durins' way of speaking is too hard to mimic.

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: No matter how much I long to integrate into their way of life... it would seem I'm still reluctant to use a word like 'Recordkeeper' as my surname.

steps.name: Expectant Durin
steps.text: Why did so many folks abstain? Looks like we're gonna have to have a fourth contest.

steps.name: Expectant Durin
steps.text: Maybe entertainment facilities aren't popular anymore? Should we go for art sculptures as the next theme?

steps.name: Relaxed Durin
steps.text: Hah, whatever it ends up being, my design's gonna be way more popular than yours for sure!

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: As designers participating in this contest, surely you two must be very familiar with the street?

steps.name: Relaxed Durin
steps.text: Of course.

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: Then would you happen to know of a workshop run by two craftsmen that used to be there half a month ago?

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: I commissioned them to make me a fountain pen, but they disappeared without a trace after they took the job.

steps.name: Relaxed Durin
steps.text: Oh...

steps.name: Relaxed Durin
steps.text: It's gotta be that place, right?

steps.name: Expectant Durin
steps.text: Gotta be.

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: What do you mean?

steps.name: Relaxed Durin
steps.text: They forgot about your commission.

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Relaxed Durin
steps.text: If not, they would've contacted you when their house was torn down.

steps.name: Expectant Durin
steps.text: Relax. It's just a fountain pen. It's not like it really matters.

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: It matters to me.

steps.name: Expectant Durin
steps.text: Oh, you're a big fan of fountain pens?

steps.name: Expectant Durin
steps.text: So are you into calligraphy? Or are you more into writing?

steps.name: Expectant Durin
steps.text: Alright, alright, quit it with the long face. When we have a huge project going on, craftsmen who aren't drunk usually come help out. You'll bump into them eventually.

steps.name: Expectant Durin
steps.text: Say, when a victor is finally crowned in this contest.

steps.name: Relaxed Durin
steps.text: Right. Speaking of the contest, I think you could give me some great ideas! Tell me, what's it like on the surface?

steps.name: Expectant Durin
steps.text: Hey, I wanted to ask her about that!

steps.name: Relaxed Durin
steps.text: In that case, let's have a vote right now, and see who she'll share her inspirations from the surface with.

steps.name: Expectant Durin
steps.text: Alright!

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: —Stop. Let's not.

steps.name: Relaxed Durin
steps.text: You don't want to tell us?

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: ...I'll tell both of you.

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: I just want someone to come up with a proposal that will win over every Durin, so I can look for the two craftsmen I commissioned as soon as possible.

steps.name: Relaxed Durin
steps.text: You were hunted?

steps.name: Relaxed Durin
steps.text: Oh—I get it! You're talking about those races where you can get in others' way!

steps.name: Expectant Durin
steps.text: Towering walls! But there was a standoff in a narrow corridor!

steps.name: Relaxed Durin
steps.text: A big reception hall! Where everyone got super drunk!

steps.name: Expectant Durin
steps.text: That's violent! Super violent!

steps.name: Relaxed Durin
steps.text: I have an idea! Let's go!

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: Do these Durins really have no idea what it means to be hunted or poisoned?

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: And I...

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: Hold on. I just told them all those hideous truths.

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: 'Inside her heart, there is nothing but towering stone walls that block out the cold wind, a corridor adorned with paintings, and a long table with nothing but hot food and fine wine on top...'

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: 'The moment she begins this sentence, she must continue her account and write about the walls that came crumbling down, the kind, tender faces in the painting that burnt away in the flames, and the blood red wine staining the white tablecloth.'

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: I've spilt the wine. Now that they've been exposed to the idea of evil, they can no longer be rid of it. Right now, all I can do is...

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: ...stop them from spreading my story through Zeruertza!

steps.name: Expectant Durin
steps.text: How come I've never thought of this before? We could've held all our contests this way!

steps.name: Relaxed Durin
steps.text: Right, now we can really battle it out with each other.

steps.name: Expectant Durin
steps.text: This is— 'The Super Water Cannon Battle!'

steps.name: Expectant Durin
steps.text: Look here. I'll put water guns at every window, guaranteed to blast whatever you end up building on the other side of street.

steps.name: Expectant Durin
steps.text: But if only one of us gets her design chosen, we won't get our showdown, no?

steps.name: Relaxed Durin
steps.text: Hm, you're right.

steps.name: Relaxed Durin
steps.text: That's why we gotta team up and join the fourth contest together!

steps.name: Expectant Durin
steps.text: Great idea!

steps.name: Durin Who's Carrying a Whole Barrel in His Arms
steps.text: You wanna advertise our brand new mead? Hm... Who're you?

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: I'm... a lover of fine drinks.

steps.name: Durin Who's Carrying a Whole Barrel in His Arms
steps.text: Oh, you love our mead? You've got great tastes, lady.

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: Since I arrived, I've seen many a Durin have this drink, and a single cup is usually enough to knock them out... My guess is it's very strong.

steps.name: Durin Who's Carrying a Whole Barrel in His Arms
steps.text: Hahaha, you know your stuff! Even I can get drunk for days on end with just two cups of this!

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: I imagine you're using an awfully large cup then.

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: But that's wonderful.

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: Let's delay no further and head out with the mead.

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: (If I treat those two designers to mead as a promotion, not only will they harbor no suspicions, they'll drink until they are absolutely inebriated.)

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: (To keep them from spreading my story around, I just need the two of them to sleep past the deadline. They might even forget about it completely.)

steps.name: Durin Who's Carrying a Whole Barrel in His Arms
steps.text: Alright, then. Let's share a toast to making this promotion a success!

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: Hold on, I've never had alcohol before...

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: (After all those sharp gazes I've had to endure, I wouldn't dare drink or let myself fall asleep in the middle of the day...)

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: No, I mean, I need to stay sober for work. Why don't we have this drink later tonight?

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: I-I'll be off now!

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: Hello, you two. Would you like to try some—

steps.name: Expectant Durin
steps.text: Hear, hear!

steps.name: Relaxed Durin
steps.text: Well said, Master Finch!

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: —They don't seem interested.

steps.name: Expectant Durin
steps.text: Amazing. The construct's contours are elegant and simple. There's absolutely no space wasted on any unnecessary surfaces.

steps.name: Relaxed Durin
steps.text: And he's right. With this design, the commercial district will have somewhat different lighting than our normal, direct artificial sunlight. With this kinda lighting, some products will look even more attractive.

steps.name: Expectant Durin
steps.text: I can't wait to see Finch's genius designs brought to life!

steps.name: Expectant Durin
steps.text: And that's even though we were gonna turn that place into a entertainment facility.

steps.name: Voice on Stage
steps.text: In that case, may all those who agree with this proposal raise their hands.

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: ...So many.

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: Even at a glance, I can tell the majority are in favor.

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: But didn't that designer use to always complain on stage about the way the Durins live?!

steps.name: Relaxed Durin
steps.text: Welp, that's our design down the drain.

steps.name: Expectant Durin
steps.text: Finch's got a point though. Over a quarter the area in Zeruertza is already used for entertainment facilities.

steps.name: Expectant Durin
steps.text: Oh hey, tall girl. Didn't see you there. Did you catch Finch's speech?

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: Yes, part of it.

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: I also happened to hear that you've abandoned the design you were working on—

steps.name: Relaxed Durin
steps.text: That aroma! Fresh mead! No doubt about it!

steps.name: Relaxed Durin
steps.text: Since we've already broken the ice, might as well help ourselves!

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: *sigh*... You don't have the slightest idea what he meant when he said you must live your lives with restraint, do you?

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: Well... this isn't so bad, either.

steps.name: Meticulous Durin
steps.text: Make way! Make way! Finch made this vending truck just for us, and we're testing out its capabilities now!

steps.name: Indolent Durin
steps.text: Faster, faster! Make a quick turn around that pillar up ahead!

steps.name: Meticulous Durin
steps.text: You sure we have room to make a turn?

steps.name: Indolent Durin
steps.text: We'll make this a crash test, then!

steps.name: Meticulous Durin
steps.text: Hm, seems safe enough. Maybe because we don't have anything in the back.

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: ...Hello.

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: I've been waiting for you ever since work on this street started.

steps.name: Meticulous Durin
steps.text: Hm? Hmm... You seem somewhat familiar.

steps.name: Meticulous Durin
steps.text: Hey, do you remember who this is?

steps.name: Indolent Durin
steps.text: What? You say something?

steps.name: Indolent Durin
steps.text: I mean, we're already lying here on the ground. I think maybe we should take a little nap first...

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: *sigh* Let me remind you, then.

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: I... I know this girl who commissioned two craftsmen on this street to make me a Durin-style fountain pen.

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: She had books in her bag and the words of her homeland in her head, but she's unwilling to touch any of them again.

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: Whenever she lifts her pen, she is reminded of the snow-drenched cloak she wore, and begins writing letters that will never be sent.

steps.name: Meticulous Durin
steps.text: Why won't they get sent? Did the railway to the next city break down or something?

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: Sorry, I digress...

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: Anyway, she just wanted something as a token, to mark her sealing away of those bygone days, after which she can finally become...

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: Hm... what would she become?

steps.name: Indolent Durin
steps.text: A scribe?

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: She wouldn't be completely saying goodbye to her past, then.

steps.name: Meticulous Durin
steps.text: So does she want this fountain pen or not?

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: ...Never mind.

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: In this story, we'll let her become a mead salesperson! Then, she'll drink merrily along with everyone else, and the smell of the alcohol will reach every corner of the artificial lake!

steps.name: Meticulous Durin
steps.text: Oh! Ohh! I like how this story turns out! I love it!

steps.name: Meticulous Durin
steps.text: It's a good thing we didn't have anything in the back of the truck. That said, I did put two barrels of mead in there!

steps.name: Indolent Durin
steps.text: What? You brought mead? You should've said so! I would've stood up so much sooner!

steps.name: Indolent Durin
steps.text: Come, cheers!

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: —I'll have a cup too. Thanks.

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: Um, actually, about twenty days ago, I commissioned you two to make me a fountain pen.

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: So... may I ask where it is?

steps.name: Meticulous Durin
steps.text: Oh, oh! It's you! Now I remember!

steps.name: Meticulous Durin
steps.text: We finished it alright, but we forgot who gave us the commission.

steps.name: Meticulous Durin
steps.text: Hold on... a fountain pen?

steps.name: Indolent Durin
steps.text: I don't think we made a fountain pen.

steps.name: Meticulous Durin
steps.text: Technically, part of it is a fountain pen.

steps.name: Meticulous Durin
steps.text: But long story short, we made a crossbow.

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: A crossbow?

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: I... Why would I want a weapon?

steps.name: Meticulous Durin
steps.text: Well, I forgot who you were, but I still remember what you told us.

steps.name: Meticulous Durin
steps.text: Your description was too vivid. I had no idea why someone would want to stab their heart with a pen, but I felt it like a crossbow bolt through my heart!

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: ...Huh?

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: Hm... Do you think you could make me an actual fountain pen this time? Also, I'd like a typewriter, too.

steps.name: Deculture Silvermint
steps.text: Avdotya, you're back.

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: Right, I want to look for magazines popular among the Durins, to see what kind of advertising copy draws their attention.

steps.name: Deculture Silvermint
steps.text: I'm pretty sure you can find those on the bookshelves right by the door. I mean, lots of people flip through them every day!

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: Many thanks.

steps.name: Deculture Silvermint
steps.text: Right, Avdotya. Avdotya... Have I seen your name somewhere recently?

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: Yes, I gave myself a Durin-style surname to make it easier to send in submissions.

steps.name: Deculture Silvermint
steps.text: Which has to mean I saw your name in a recent magazine.

steps.name: Deculture Silvermint
steps.text: And I thought you didn't want to write anymore.

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: ...There were two Durins who made me a collectible that's even more suited for sealing away my past.

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: As for the fountain pen and typewriter... there's no harm in continuing to use them.

steps.name: Deculture Silvermint
steps.text: Oh, I've found it! Avdotya...

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: ...'Razorpen.'

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: I... I must keep writing.

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: After all, I know I can't truly leave it behind me.
